visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a woman's leg with a red, irritated patch of skin, with a large '痛' (Pain) graphic overlay and sweat-drop emojis. (2) The scene cuts to the woman in a white shirt and black skirt sitting on a gray sofa, pulling a beige pain-relief patch off her waist with a pained expression. (3) She faces the camera directly, holding two crumpled patches, shaking her head to indicate 'no' while a graphic shows an angel halo over her head. (4) Transitioning to a product showcase, she holds a white bottle of 'DR. GRAND MA' cream and a uniquely shaped light-gray massage tool with dark speckles. (5) Close-up shots follow, rotating the 'Volcanic Stone Massage Plate' to show its ergonomic ridges and logo. (6) A montage of short clips demonstrates the tool being used on the back of her head, neck, shoulders, and legs. (7) Technical graphics appear, showing a quality certificate and a chart for far-infrared emissivity. (8) The woman applies white cream to her leg and uses the tool in a rhythmic upward motion. (9) Icons appear summarizing safety features: no fragrance, no pigment, no parabens, no mineral oil. (10) A step-by-step tutorial begins with the woman's back to the camera, showing four distinct massage techniques on the neck and lymph nodes. (11) Comparison shots show the 'before and after' effect on her neck swelling. (12) Finally, she holds both products near her face, smiling and speaking enthusiastically to the viewer.

It positions the volcanic stone massage tool and magnesium cream as a more effective, natural, and soothing alternative for muscle tension.
